Pixel OS v2.1.0-b1 — Opt-In iOS Style UI Beta on Android 17 for Realme X2 Pro (RMX1931)
• Full iOS 26 Liquid Glass Experience (Opt-In Beta Channel): 90Hz Liquid Glass Home Screen Dock & Q Search Pill, 129 multi-plane iOS 26 icons (Auto / Default / Dark / Clear), and pure left-right SpringBoard navigation
• 1:1 iOS 26 Lock Screen, Notification Center & Control Center (IosControlCenter): oversized hero refractive clock, stacked notifications, expanded media platter, Goodix G3 UDFPS zone, and Dock-calibrated AGSL meniscus refraction
• Standalone iOS 26 Settings (IosSettings), iCall 26 Phone Dialer (ROLE_DIALER), Liquid Glass Messages (IosMessages, ROLE_SMS), and 90Hz iOS Styler calibration studio (20% Refraction / 20% Frost / 70% Depth defaults)
• Shared PixelOS Core: Linux 4.14.356 eBPF + Chrome 156+ zygote_next fix, Pixel 9 GCam 9.6 Quad-Camera HAL, 90Hz OLED DC Dimming, brightness/HBM calibration, and two-way switch back to Stable PixelOS anytime in Settings -> System -> System update
